eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Chelan, WA; at 9:35 AM on AUG 11, 2025 Effective until 11:35 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Chelan County Sheriff WILDFIRE WARNING, Level 2 Evacuation Advisory in Lake Wenatchee. The affected area is North of Lk Wenatchee Highway, Brown Road, Fir Drive, Maple Drive, Bruce Lane, Byron lane, and Lakeview Drive. Roads and evacuation routes can become blocked. If you do not leave now, you could be trapped, injured, or killed. For updates check Local Radio, TV or the Chelan County Emergency Management Website and Facebook.
